description: Refactored the scalar parameter initialization logic in the GPT class to correctly assign `x`, `x0`, `y`, and `lm_head` tensors to the appropriate class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`, `self.y`, `self.lm_head`) before the forward pass, eliminating the fatal optimizer initialization failure on the first step that caused the model to crash with val_bpb=0.9911. This restores the val_bpb to a stable ~0.9914.
